git_changes.method: Selected mathematical patches only; no donor parent or bundle imported.

tickets.semantics: Historical identities, statuses, dependencies and mathematical requirements; operational-only identities carry an omission disposition.

notes.semantics: Projected mathematical specifications and assessments with source hashes and current correspondence owners.

excluded: Environment setup, native kit and toolchain distribution
Diagnostics, troubleshooting, compiler transcripts and logs
Caches, build outputs and packaging machinery
Historical agent policy and execution instructions
history_boundary: Exclusions apply to every newly introduced commit, not just the final tree. Existing checkpoint-012 history and its restoration registry are unchanged.
other_refs: All 158 non-new advertised ref tips were already represented in receiving ancestry, using the prior rewrite registry where needed. No independent new side-branch mathematics was found.
